We are aiming to have a first-pass manifest and basic validation done within 3 weeks to keep co-sell timelines. I attached our initial RFP so you have context.

Hi Nathan — great to meet you (virtually) and thanks for the RFP. Looping in here the publisher onboarding checklist and a pragmatic path to get you into the Azure Marketplace sandbox quickly.

What we need from Acme to start publisher enrollment (legal/identity proofs):
1) Company registration document (pdf)
2) Signed publisher agreement (we can circulate a DocuSign)
3) Primary contact (name + corporate email) and delegated signatory name
4) W-9 / tax ID (US publishers) or equivalent tax form for non-US
5) Basic logo + product description (lo-res images ok for staging)

Technical artifacts for manifest + publish:
- Azure tenant ID you will use for publishing (and the subscription ID if you want us to test deploy)
- Service Principal (SPN) with Contributor on the test subscription OR instructions to add our test SPN (we prefer SPN ownership for sandbox validation)
- ARM template or container image URI (ACR / DockerHub) for the listing
- SKU mapping guidance (per-environment pricing, free trial flags)

Sandbox / validation path (minimum viable):
- Option A (fast): You provide a test subscription + add our test SPN; we run the manifest deploy and validate flows (10–14 business days).
- Option B (no test tenant): We provide a bootstrap manifest and small ARM template you can run in a dev tenant; we then run remote validation on outputs and do smoke tests (7–10 business days).

Attachments I’m sharing: marketplace-checklist.xlsx (checklist + required fields), publisher-guides.zip (examples + manifest templates).

Recommended next steps / timeline:
- Please send the company registration doc + tenant ID this week.
- We’ll circulate a DocuSign for the publisher agreement (Marissa) — signing speeds enrollment.
- Schedule a 60-minute technical validation call with Vivek next week to walk through networking and the push flow.

Nathan — if this looks good I’ll kick off the DocuSign and share the checklist as a Google folder.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Marketplace Onboarding Lead, Redwood Inference
Attachments: marketplace-checklist.xlsx (excel), publisher-guides.zip (zip)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>

Thanks Alex / Marissa. Nathan — quick technical notes to help you prepare for the validation call and to clarify our sandbox requirements.

Networking and connectivity
- Outbound egress: ensure your environment allows outbound to Azure storage, ACR endpoints, and our validation IP ranges. We’ll provide a short CIDR list in the follow-up.
- If you publish a managed app that requires inbound connectivity (rare), you must document expected ports and NAT behavior.

Identity / certs
- For SPN approach: create an App Registration and grant it Contributor on the test subscription. Send the App ID + Tenant ID + one client secret (rotated after validation).
- If you want us to use the Publisher Portal to validate, we need the publisher account owner to accept an invite and we’ll run validations from our Azure tooling (preferred).

Runtime / validation tests
- Smoke tests we run: manifest parsing, install via ARM template, runtime health check (3 requests/min for 5 min), artifact integrity hash.
- Please provide a simple healthcheck endpoint or container that responds 200 for a lightweight smoke test.

Deliverables we’ll produce
- Validation report (pass/fail with step-level notes)
- Manifest linting notes and SKU recommendations
- Sandbox test plan (I attached the lightweight test-plan.md and a sample network diagram).

Proposed timeslot for technical validation call: Thu 2026-04-08 09:30 PT / 12:30 ET — does that work for your engineering manager? If not, propose two alternatives.

Attachments: network-arch.png (png), test-plan.md (markdown)

—Vivek
Principal Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
